changeSet.author: mrodek
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE br_control (id integer PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1)); INSERT INTO br_control(id) VALUES (1); CREATE TABLE br_seasons ( id varchar(7) PRIMARY KEY, starts_at timestamptz NOT NULL, ends_at timestamptz NOT NULL CHECK (ends_at > starts_at) ); CREATE TABLE br_ratings ( uid varchar(128) PRIMARY KEY, player_name varchar(64) NOT NULL, mu double precision NOT NULL DEFAULT 25, sigma double precision NOT NULL DEFAULT 8.333333333333334 CHECK (sigma > 0), br integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1000 CHECK (br >= 0), best_br integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1000, games integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (games >= 0), wins integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (wins >= 0 AND wins <= games), last_played_at timestamptz ); CREATE TABLE br_matches ( id bigserial PRIMARY KEY, match_id uuid NOT NULL UNIQUE, season_id varchar(7) NOT NULL REFERENCES br_seasons(id), room_id varchar(128) NOT NULL, started_at timestamptz NOT NULL, finished_at timestamptz NOT NULL CHECK (finished_at >= started_at), outcome varchar(16) NOT NULL CHECK (outcome IN ('COMPLETED','FORFEIT','CANCELLED')), winner_team char(1) CHECK (winner_team IN ('A','B')), policy_version integer NOT NULL, algorithm_version varchar(64) NOT NULL, review_flag varchar(64), report jsonb NOT NULL, recorded_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), CHECK ((outcome = 'CANCELLED' AND winner_team IS NULL) OR (outcome <> 'CANCELLED' AND winner_team IS NOT NULL)) ); CREATE TABLE br_rating_changes ( match_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES br_matches(match_id), uid varchar(128) NOT NULL REFERENCES br_ratings(uid), seat smallint NOT NULL CHECK (seat BETWEEN 0 AND 3), won boolean NOT NULL, mu_before double precision NOT NULL, sigma_before double precision NOT NULL, br_before integer NOT NULL, mu_after double precision NOT NULL, sigma_after double precision NOT NULL, br_after integer NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (match_id, uid), UNIQUE (match_id, seat) ); CREATE TABLE br_season_standings ( season_id varchar(7) NOT NULL REFERENCES br_seasons(id), uid varchar(128) NOT NULL REFERENCES br_ratings(uid), games integer NOT NULL CHECK (games > 0), wins integer NOT NULL CHECK (wins >= 0 AND wins <= games), br integer NOT NULL, best_br integer NOT NULL, last_played_at timestamptz NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (season_id, uid) ); CREATE TABLE br_season_awards ( season_id varchar(7) NOT NULL REFERENCES br_seasons(id), place smallint NOT NULL CHECK (place BETWEEN 1 AND 3), uid varchar(128) NOT NULL REFERENCES br_ratings(uid), br integer NOT NULL, games integer NOT NULL, wins integer NOT NULL, awarded_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), PRIMARY KEY (season_id, place), UNIQUE (season_id, uid) ); CREATE INDEX idx_br_active_ranking ON br_ratings(br DESC, last_played_at) WHERE games >= 20; CREATE INDEX idx_br_changes_uid ON br_rating_changes(uid); CREATE INDEX idx_br_matches_finished ON br_matches(finished_at); CREATE INDEX idx_br_standings_ranking ON br_season_standings(season_id, br DESC);
